primary_critical_paths.finding: Source extraction is a fact-foundation path. The dominant avoidable delays are serial source discovery, duplicate full-source decode/read, waiting for unrelated slow extraction units, and rebuilding evidence for downstream writers/reviewers.
primary_critical_paths.candidate_action: Build one manifest after archive PASS, assign stable source_id/fingerprint/locator/expected coverage, dispatch independent sources in the same ready wave, consume each result on arrival, join coverage/conflicts once, and reuse evidence_pack downstream. Intra-file fanout is allowed only after a structural index enables locator-bounded reads without re-decoding the whole file in every child.
primary_critical_paths.accuracy_boundary: No speedup may reduce source coverage, formula/table structure, locator fidelity, conflict preservation, source fingerprint binding, or explicit unread/unverified reporting. PDF page-range parallelism requires stable page-level access; scanned/image pages remain explicit visual/unverified coverage rather than guessed text.

primary_critical_paths.finding: Review delay is driven by late reviewer creation, unnecessary serial reviewer dispatch, redundant full-source reparse, and global re-review invalidation when only one artifact changes.
primary_critical_paths.candidate_action: Prepare reviewer ready-set before freeze, launch ready independent reviewers in the same scheduling decision after immutable hashes exist, consume structured PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results on arrival, use artifact-scoped review evidence plus one full/cross-artifact consistency review, and invalidate only changed/dependent scopes.
primary_critical_paths.quality_boundary: Per-artifact minimum reviewer coverage is enforced mechanically. T4-T6 requires at least one independent reviewer per required artifact; T7+ requires at least two distinct reviewers per required artifact. Multi-artifact delivery additionally requires a valid full/cross-artifact consistency review. Shared-fact changes still invalidate dependent scopes even when file hashes are unchanged.

secondary_hot_path_findings.finding: A global single-writer interpretation serialized independent DOCX/XLSX production.
secondary_hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Use one writer per artifact/path with isolated scratch after the shared fact baseline is stable.

secondary_hot_path_findings.finding: Thread parallelism was negative; process parallelism materially reduced wall clock for heavy independent OOXML inspections.
secondary_hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Use process-parallel batch inspection only when independence and positive net benefit are established; fall back to identical serial checks if process infrastructure is unavailable.

secondary_hot_path_findings.finding: Routine non-light entry previously fixed-loaded Core + Router + classification + routing map.
secondary_hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Keep Router as the routine hot core and load other modules only when they change the current decision.

secondary_hot_path_findings.finding: Fixture timings remain in the tens-of-milliseconds range and do not identify Delivery Gate mechanics as an end-to-end dominant cost.
secondary_hot_path_findings.candidate_action: Keep fail-closed delivery semantics; the only review-related Gate change is scoped evidence validation to avoid unnecessary unrelated re-review while strengthening per-artifact coverage.

implemented_changes: T0 builds a minimal dependency DAG and same-wave ready-set for independent positive-benefit work.
Source archive PASS immediately leads to one source manifest with stable source_id, type, fingerprint/hash, locator scheme and expected coverage.
Independent sources dispatch in the same extraction wave; completed results are consumed immediately instead of waiting for unrelated slow units.
Large single files are not blindly split: intra-file parallelism requires one structural index and locator-bounded reads that avoid duplicate full-source decode.
Text/Word, Excel and PDF extraction share the same evidence contract while preserving format-specific coverage and unread/unverified states.
Source extraction is reused through evidence_pack; unreasoned duplicate full-source rereads are disallowed.
Agent Result carries source identity/fingerprint plus dispatch ready/start/complete timing fields when a reliable time source exists.
Reviewer ready-set may be prepared before candidate freeze, but verdict work starts only after immutable candidate hashes exist.
Ready independent reviewers launch in the same scheduling decision and return structured completion feedback directly; no second result-query chain is required.
Delivery Gate supports backward-compatible full review plus artifact-scoped and cross-artifact review evidence.
Every required artifact must independently meet the original reviewer-strength requirement; scoped review cannot reduce review coverage.

Rework of one artifact invalidates its scoped review plus full/cross-artifact consistency review, while unrelated unchanged artifact reviews may be reused when bytes, hashes and dependent facts are unchanged.
Routine non-light fixed control loading is reduced from four modules to Router-only with conditional loading for the rest.
Independent final artifacts use one writer per artifact/path and may be produced in parallel after a stable shared fact baseline.
Independent nontrivial DOCX/XLSX mechanical inspections may use process-parallel batch checks only when expected net benefit is positive; process failure falls back to the same serial checks.
Simple tasks remain single-executor and quality/review gates remain fail-closed.

performance_iterations.workload: 6 separate runs of 8 independent synthetic DOCX inspections with 24000 paragraphs each
performance_iterations.interpretation: Component-level synthetic evidence only; not an end-to-end real-office speed claim.
Structural context/load proxy only; not a wall-clock speed claim.

performance_iterations.evidence: Two required artifacts pass with separate artifact-scoped reviews plus one cross-artifact review; removing one artifact review fails closed; after changing only the document artifact, its scoped review and the cross-artifact review can be refreshed while the unchanged ledger review evidence remains byte-identical and valid.
performance_iterations.interpretation: Proves targeted review invalidation semantics and preserved coverage. Actual review wall-clock reduction still requires target-work A/B.

hosted_macos_module_diagnostic.known_runtime_issue: The lifecycle case can fail inside the full test_evolution_loop module on GitHub-hosted macOS because the maintenance sandbox cannot initialize in that hosted process state; the identical lifecycle case passes in a fresh process in the same workflow.
